uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds input; expected values produced by running reference/upstream-codec.js and re-keying to the normalized vocabulary. bytes[6..7]=0xFFCE decodes via two's complement to -50 deci-C = -5.0 C — the sub-zero leaf state the vendor calls out (freezing).
